ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.2 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal 50% of both left and right fluke lobes are characterized by contiguous high-intensity white patches. The central 50% area, extending from the peduncle to the median notch, is comprised of low-intensity black pixels. The right white patch contains a distinct low-intensity focal spot.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated 90-degree V-shaped notch with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge (2-4 pixel variance). The distal tips of both lobes exhibit high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness with significant pixel-depth variations from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary concave curve from the median notch extending to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight convex upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 15 localized, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (3-6 pixel diameter) scattered across the dark central and lower lateral surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark linear disruptions crossing the white patch on the left lobe; multiple vertical dark streaks observed on the white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss or jagged erosion on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe relative to the smoother contour of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast circular black focal spot (approx. 10 pixels in diameter) located in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe's white patch.
